part5.q: Ms. Ford thanked the volunteers for _____ hard work at the charity run.

part5.q: The new parking garage will greatly improve _____ to the shopping center.
part5.explanation: Improve + tân ngữ là danh từ: improve access to.

part5.q: The store will stay open late on Friday _____ customers can shop after work.
part5.explanation: So that + mệnh đề chỉ mục đích: để khách có thể mua sắm sau giờ làm.

part5.q: All employees must _____ with the new security guidelines starting May 1.
part5.explanation: Comply with = tuân thủ.

part5.q: The new marketing director _____ at a reception next Tuesday.
part5.explanation: Giám đốc được giới thiệu (bị động), next Tuesday → will be introduced.

part5.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ spoke cần trạng từ: persuasively.

part5.explanation: Within + khoảng thời gian = trong vòng.

part5.q: Mr. Liu will attend the trade fair on _____ of the company president.
part5.explanation: On behalf of = thay mặt cho.

part5.q: The award will go to the employee _____ suggestion saves the most money.
part5.explanation: Suggestion thuộc về employee → whose.

part5.q: The proposal was rejected because of its _____ cost.
part5.explanation: Trước danh từ cost cần tính từ: excessive.

part5.q: The museum is _____ closed on Mondays for cleaning.
part5.explanation: Regularly closed on Mondays = đóng cửa định kỳ vào thứ Hai.

part5.q: We suggest _____ your seats early because the event usually sells out.
part5.explanation: Suggest + V-ing: suggest reserving.

part5.q: _____ the train was delayed, Ms. Ito arrived at the meeting on time.
part5.explanation: Mệnh đề tương phản: tàu trễ nhưng vẫn đến đúng giờ → Even though.

part5.q: Visitors are reminded that photography is _____ prohibited inside the gallery.
part5.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ prohibited cần trạng từ: strictly.

part5.q: Our new supplier has agreed to _____ the cost of shipping for orders over $500.
part5.explanation: Cover the cost = chi trả chi phí.

part5.q: The library will remain open _____ 10 P.M. during the exam period.
part5.explanation: Until + mốc = kéo dài đến (hành động liên tục remain open).

part5.q: If the weather _____ good tomorrow, the company picnic will be held at Lakeside Park.
part5.explanation: Mệnh đề if loại 1 dùng hiện tại đơn: If the weather is good.

part5.q: The manager was _____ with the results of the customer survey.
part5.explanation: Người cảm thấy hài lòng → tính từ -ed: satisfied with.

part5.q: Due to rising demand, the factory will _____ production by 20 percent.
part5.explanation: Increase production = tăng sản lượng.

part5.q: Applicants must submit _____ a résumé or a portfolio of recent work.
part5.explanation: Cặp liên từ either ... or.

part5.q: Please _____ attention to the safety instructions before using the machine.
part5.explanation: Cụm cố định pay attention to = chú ý.

part5.q: The company's profits rose _____ after it launched its online store.
part5.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ rose cần trạng từ: dramatically.

part5.q: By the time Ms. Moreau joined the firm, it _____ offices in five countries.
part5.explanation: Hành động xảy ra trước một mốc quá khứ (joined) → quá khứ hoàn thành: had opened.

part5.q: Of the three proposals, the board preferred the one _____ Mr. Silva submitted.
part5.explanation: Thay cho vật (the one = proposal) làm tân ngữ → that.

part5.q: The new software is fully _____ with the computers in our office.
part5.explanation: Compatible with = tương thích với.

part5.q: _____ the support of local businesses, the festival raised over $50,000 for charity.
part5.explanation: Thanks to = nhờ có, chỉ nguyên nhân tích cực.

Dear Customer,

Our records show that you purchased a HomeChef 300 electric kettle between January and March of this year. We have learned that the switch on some of these kettles may not turn off automatically when the water boils.

Although no injuries have been reported, we are asking customers to stop using the kettle immediately. Please return it to any HomeChef retailer for a free replacement, or mail it to us using the enclosed prepaid label. You will receive a new kettle within two weeks.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
HomeChef Customer Care

passages.content:
Harper University Media Center — Equipment Loans

Students and staff may borrow cameras, microphones, and tripods free of charge. Items may be kept for up to three days. Projectors are available to staff only and may be kept for one day.

Late returns are charged $10 per day. To borrow equipment, complete a request form at least 24 hours in advance.

Status: Staff

Dear Dr. Tran,

Your equipment request has been approved. However, both of our wireless microphones are reserved on Monday. We can provide two wired microphones instead, which work with all classroom speakers. If this is acceptable, no further action is needed. Your items will be ready at the front counter.

Media Center Staff

passages.title: Customer review
passages.content:
Reviewed by Tom H., posted on Monday

I came here for the lunch special with two coworkers. The lamb was excellent and the bread was still warm. Service was a little slow because the restaurant was very busy, but our server apologized and brought us free desserts. I will definitely return with my whole team of twelve.

passages.title: System upgrade
passages.content:
To all staff of Carlton Insurance:

Our customer database will be upgraded this month. During each department's scheduled upgrade window, the database will be unavailable for about four hours. Please save your work and log out before your window begins. Staff who need to access customer records during that time should contact the IT help desk in advance.
